attr.title: Mega Man X regenesis
attr.desc: Note: This game is hard to run so it comes with a preconfigured save file with lighting and partical effects turned off. If you wish to create or add a save file I HIGHLY recommend that you turn off lighting and partical effects. Game Description: Set in an alternate timeline following the events of Mega Man X, Sigma has won, X has fallen, and humanity stands on the brink of extinction. Just when all hope appears lost, Dr. Cain unveils his final contingency—Project Regenesis. Given one last chance to rewrite history, X must rise once again and fight to save what remains of humanity.
attr.inst: Download the latest Windows version of the game from https://mmxregenesis.itch.io/mega-man-x-regenesis#download/, extract the exe and place it into the game data folder within the ports directory.
